description: Introduction and overview of the AC-130 Gunship: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The AC-130 is a four-engine gunship built by Lockheed on the C-130 airframe, entering service in 1968. It circles targets while side-firing weapons — up to a 105 mm howitzer, 40 mm cannon, and 25 mm gun — deliver sustained precision fire. The latest AC-130J Ghostrider carries the 105 mm gun plus precision munitions. Baseline facts: C-130-based gunship; service from 1968; side-firing weapons including a 105 mm howitzer..
